description: Run a find query against a MongoDB collection

collection.description: Name of the collection to query.

database.description: Name of the MongoDB database containing the collection.

filter.description: MongoDB query filter document matching the documents to return.

limit.description: Maximum number of documents to return; must be positive.

projection.description: Projection document controlling which fields are returned in each document.

sort.description: Sort document mapping each field to its sort direction (1 for ascending, -1 for descending).

name: find
